subject: Lycogala slime mold
creator: Christine Young
alt: A fingertip presses a mature brown Lycogala fruiting body on decaying wood as a pale cloud of spores streams outward across the frame.
detail: Finger pressure and airborne material are visible. Genus-level Lycogala identification is retained. Feeling, later withdrawal and personal continuity with the released spores are fiction, not a claim of conscious spore control.
